projects.title: AI-Powered Email Management Web App
projects.subtitle: Freelance Project
points: Engineered a backend and AI-powered features to automate email organization, prioritization and personalized draft generation

Optimized asynchronous email processing using Redis & BullMQ to classify **5 emails per batch**, reducing LLM API requests by **up to 80%** and minimizing redundant token usage to lower AI processing costs
Implemented RAG pipeline via embeddings and Pinecone VectorDB to retrieve relevant email context & generate personalized AI drafts, reducing repetitive manual email writing

projects.title: AI Assistant
projects.subtitle: Industrial Project for Auto BIM Route and Mintplex Labs
points: Owned the end-to-end document ingestion pipeline by building a Python REST endpoint on API Gateway and Lambda that validated and stored uploads in Amazon S3, improving experience and productivity
Built and integrated a speaking avatar into a React frontend using Hugging Face model inference and browser-based TTS for lip-sync, eliminating **$3,000/month** in licensing costs
